title: Prepare heavy initialization for lazy loading (first phase)
summary: Names what an initialization section does; --apply moves its body verbatim into a run-once routine, through a scratch build and the compile gate
intro: Read this when the heavy-initialization rule reports a unit and you want the work out of the section. This first phase changes no behaviour: the plan shows which statement is heavy and which global could go lazy, and --apply only extracts the body, so that moving the call later is a one-line change.
